ValidationRule.description: Priority drives the first-response SLA and the 8-business-hour escalation, so no agent saves a Case without one. Bypass: Bypass_Case_Intake_Validation (M2-S01). Rationale: deploy-order.md.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Set a Priority before saving this case. The first-response SLA and the escalation clock both read Priority, so a case saved without one is not picked up on time. Choose the Priority this report warrants and save again.
